An original young woman with long dark hair and a
ribbon tied at the back of her head poses in a
black-and-white portrait. She wears a white
off-shoulder blouse with voluminous puff sleeves
and a small pearl earring. Her expression is calm
and composed. A soft gray, misty landscape
painted on the backdrop, with gentle studio lighting.
Monochrome palette of white, gray, and black.
